headline: Florida Tech clinch first place
dek: Florida Tech beat Florida Southern on Wednesday in the last match either side has scheduled, and stand four points clear of Embry-Riddle, who were held at Palm Beach Atlantic the same night. Embry-Riddle's one remaining match, against Tampa, cannot close that gap.
displaced_by: Florida Tech beat Florida Southern on 2026-10-28, so the standing dek no longer holds: it was not Florida Southern's second defeat, they are no longer level with Embry-Riddle, and the Wednesday match has been played

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Florida Southern have outscored every other programme, but goals have not settled the table: Florida Tech lead it on a total from the middle of the pack.

wire.line: Florida Tech have finished their schedule top of the table, and no side with a match left can reach them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Palm Beach Atlantic's home matches against Florida Atlantic, Barry and Strive Academy, and Eckerd's home match against Trinity in September, have all passed their date with no result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Kobi Thomas has scored seventeen of Palm Beach Atlantic's 28 goals this season, from 61 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finlay Prain has scored fifteen of Rollins' 25 goals this season, from 61 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Marcos da Silva has kept five clean sheets for Embry-Riddle.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Nova Southeastern have conceded 34 goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

last_match.line: Florida Tech have lost only at Embry-Riddle in conference play; Florida Southern have now lost back-to-back.

next_match.line: Saint Leo arrive on a winning run; Rollins have not won since beating Nova Southeastern.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
